title: Metafxclub EA-ready Strategy Research Blueprint v2
description: Canonical, closed-bar strategy research contract. Verification of sources and readiness for EA handoff are independent states. Cross-series operand equality is additionally verified by the Python contract validator.

field.description: Closed deterministic operand-field registry. The semantic validator additionally checks that the selected field belongs to the selected operand kind.

testPayload.description: Bounded non-empty test fixture payload; the Python gate also enforces a 16 KiB serialized limit.
